March, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 554 of 2022
Applicant :- Arun Tripathi
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of Home. Lko.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Chandra Shekhar Sinha,Gaurav Verma Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
Heard Shri Chandra Shekhar Sinha, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for State and perused the record.

The present anticipatory bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Arun Tripathi in Case Crime No.129 of 2021 under Sections 420, 409 I.P.C., Police Station Gomti Nagar, District Lucknow, with the prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail as he is apprehending arrest in the above-mentioned case.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case and has not committed any offence as claimed by the prosecution.

It is further submitted that the applicant was only an employee in the sister concern of the Company (against whom allegation of misappropriation is being leveled) namely Anee Bullion Commodity Brokers Private Limited and he was appointed as Assistant Manager therein and was not having any concern with the affairs of M/s Anee Bullion Traders and he himself is the victim of circumstances as he himself had invested huge amount and about Rs.19,50,000- is still remaining on the M/s Anee Bullion Traders and he had himself lodged an F.I.R. against the Directors and other office bearers of the said Company.

It is further submitted that even in the statement of the informant(who is also being arrayed as an accused after investigation) no specific role of any kind has been assigned to the instant applicant and all the allegations are leveled against the Chief Managing Director of M/s Anee Bullion Traders,
namely-Ajit Kumar Gupta and a sweeping allegation has been leveled against the applicant and other co-accused persons.

It is further submitted that only on the basis of apprehension and suspicion, the applicant was involved in 11 criminal cases, however, in rest of the cases excluding this one, the applicant has been granted anticipatory bail by the subordinate courts or by the Co-ordinate Benches of this Court vide orders dated 19.05.2022 passed by Coordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/s438 Cr.P.C. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No.1085 of 2022, order dated 14.07.2022 passed in by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc.
Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No.1114 of 2022, order dated 14.07.2022 passed by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C.
No.1115 of 2022, order dated 03.06.2022 passed by court below in Anticipatory Bail Application No.3903/2022, order dated 30.05.2022 passed by court below in Anticipatory Bail Application No.3174/2022, order dated 11.05.2022 passed by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No.684 of 2022 and order dated 20.07.2022 passed by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No.771 of 2022.

It is also submitted that the applicant is having roots in the society and there is no apprehension that after being released on anticipatory bail he may flee from the courts of law or misuse the liberty,
moreover, he is cooperating in the investigation and undertakes that he would continue to cooperate in the investigation and will remain present before the Investigating Officer as and when his presence would be required and he will also cooperate in the expeditious disposal of the case, in case the charge-sheet is filed against him.
Learned A.G.A. on the other opposes the prayer of anticipatory bail of the applicant on the ground that huge amount has been misappropriated by the office bearers of the Company in question and the instant applicant was also involved in the criminal conspiracy.

Having heard submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that in the F.I.R. as well as in the statement of the informant who according to the learned counsel for the applicant has subsequently been arrayed as an accused, no specific role of any kind has been assigned to the instant applicant and the thrust of the allegation was against the Chief Managing Director, namely-Ajit Kumar Gupta of M/s Anee Bullion Traders.

The applicant has admittedly lodged an F.I.R. against the office bearers, including the Chief Managing Director namely-Ajit Kumar Gupta, of the Anee Bullion Traders bearing Case Crime No.664 of 2020 under Section 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 406 and 506, I.P.C. at Police Station P.G.I. sentences.text: The applicant has already been granted facility of Anticipatory Bail by the Subordinate Courts and Co-ordinate Benches of this Court in the other 11 cases which have been shown as the criminal history of the applicant.
However, identical allegations appears to have been leveled in those cases also.

Keeping in view all the fact and circumstances of the present case and law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in keeping in view the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Gurbaksh Singh Sibbia vs. State of Punjab [(1980) 2 SCC 565 : 1980 SCC (Cri) 561], Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra (2011) 1 SCC 694 as well as in Sushila Aggarwal v. State (NCT of Delhi) (2020) 5 SCC 1 and in Nathu Singh Vs State of U.P. and Others, 2021(6) SCC 64,
MANU/SC/0360/2021, protection from arrest till submission of police report under Section 173 (2)
Cr.P.C. may be granted to the applicant.
Thus, the anticipatory bail application moved by the applicant is finally disposed of in terms that till submission of police report under Section 173 (2) Cr.P.C, the applicant, namely- Arun Tripathi involved in the above noted case, shall be released forthwith on anticipatory bail on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 50,000/- and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer of the Police Station concerned/ Investigating Officer, trial court concerned,
subject to the following conditions:-
(1) The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation or for discovery of any fact before the investigating officer as and when required and for this purpose shall provide his mobile phone number to the investigating officer, in writing.

(3) The applicant shall not leave the District concerned without the previous permission of the Court or investigating officer.
